scope: Completes the419 ranked records, not all5902 outer records. Combined three selections contain433 distinct source/ID records, not433 independent experiments.
limits: Original abstract appraisals, not full-paper review or empirical replication. Some records are reviews or publication versions; drug identity absent from an abstract remains unknown. Nominees and alternatives share the actual-allele evidence gap.

records.title: Bub3 promotes Cdc20-dependent activation of the APC/C in S. cerevisiae.
records.model: Budding yeast bub3 deletion and Cdc20 overexpression
records.note: Cdc20 overexpression reversed a metaphase delay caused by poor APC/C association after Bub3 loss.
records.uncertainty: Genetic timing rescue is not drug-mediated fidelity or muscle rescue.

records.title: Mitotic Checkpoint Kinase Mps1 Has a Role in Normal Physiology which Impacts Clinical Utility.

agent_roles.role: challenge: Mps1 blockade causing tumor killing and systemic toxicity
challenge: potent Mps1 inhibitor
benefit: pretreatment reduces inhibitor-induced marrow apoptosis

records.model: Triple-negative breast cancer models, mice and human bone-marrow cells
records.note: Mps1 inhibition suppressed tumors only at toxic exposures; palbociclib pretreatment reduced marrow apoptosis through cell-cycle protection.
records.uncertainty: Protection during imposed Mps1 toxicity does not establish productive progenitor renewal or MVA benefit.

records.title: Zwint-1 is required for spindle assembly checkpoint function and kinetochore-microtubule attachment during oocyte meiosis.

agent_roles.role: challenge: Aurora inhibition

records.model: Zwint-1-depleted oocytes with Aurora-inhibitor washout
records.note: Zwint-1 loss impaired checkpoint recruitment and raised aneuploidy; inhibitor washout repaired alignment only when Zwint-1 remained intact.
records.uncertainty: Washout recovery is not benefit from continued Aurora inhibition.

records.title: Requirement for PLK1 kinase activity in the maintenance of a robust spindle assembly checkpoint.

agent_roles.role: challenge: mitotic arrest

records.model: Nocodazole-arrested U2OS cells with kinase inhibition
records.note: PLK1 supported kinetochore Aurora-B localization; combined partial Aurora-B inhibition efficiently overrode the checkpoint.
records.uncertainty: PLK1/Aurora/MPS1/Haspin inhibitor identities are absent; checkpoint escape is not faithful division.

records.title: Nuclear pore protein NUP88 activates anaphase-promoting complex to promote aneuploidy.

agent_roles.role: challenge: induces Nup88 expression

records.model: Inducible Nup88-overexpressing mice and PLK1-insufficient comparisons
records.note: NUP88 excess promoted premature PLK1 destruction, spindle asymmetry and aneuploidy, with intestinal tumor susceptibility.
records.uncertainty: Doxycycline is an expression-system trigger; PLK1 insufficiency is not a therapeutic normalization experiment.

records.title: Systemic Chromosome Instability Resulted in Colonic Transcriptomic Changes in Metabolic, Proliferation, and Stem Cell Regulators in Sgo1-/+ Mice.

agent_roles.role: challenge: colon carcinogen

records.model: Sgo1-haploinsufficient mouse colon after carcinogen exposure
records.note: Chromosome instability accompanied altered metabolic, stem-cell and immune transcripts in apparently normal colonic mucosa.
records.uncertainty: Pathway enrichment proposes targets but tests no restorative treatment.

records.title: Mechanism of APC/CCDC20 activation by mitotic phosphorylation.
records.model: Reconstituted human APC/C phosphosite mutants
records.note: APC1-loop phosphorylation relieved autoinhibition and allowed CDC20 binding; loop deletion bypassed that phosphorylation requirement.
records.uncertainty: Biochemical activation and engineered mutants are not pharmacological repair.

records.title: Identification of genes that are essential to restrict genome duplication to once per cell division.

agent_roles.role: challenge: excess replication enhanced by gene suppression

records.model: Human TP53-positive/negative cancer-cell siRNA screen
records.note: A genome-wide screen found 42 genes restricting repeated replication; suppressing protective genes sensitized cells to paclitaxel-induced excess DNA.
records.uncertainty: Other chemical/apoptosis inhibitors are unnamed; proposed synthetic lethality is an oncology outcome.

records.title: Dual mechanisms regulate the recruitment of spindle assembly checkpoint proteins to the budding yeast kinetochore.
records.model: Budding-yeast kinetochore binding and MELT-repeat analysis
records.note: Bub1 abundance and steric recruitment limits constrained checkpoint complexes, while at least three MELT repeats supported accurate segregation.
records.uncertainty: No administered treatment or tissue-rescue endpoint.

records.title: Zfp207 is a Bub3 binding protein regulating meiotic chromosome alignment in mouse oocytes.

agent_roles.role: challenge: checkpoint arrest

records.model: Mouse oocytes depleted of Zfp207 with Bub3 addback
records.note: Bub3 overexpression partly reduced aneuploid eggs after Zfp207 depletion, which otherwise destabilized attachments and checkpoint function.
records.uncertainty: Protein overexpression is the rescue; nocodazole is a challenge rather than a restorative agent.

records.title: Systemic chromosome instability in Shugoshin-1 mice resulted in compromised glutathione pathway, activation of Wnt signaling and defects in immune system in the lung.
records.model: Sgo1-haploinsufficient and Rag1-deficient mouse lungs
records.note: Combining chromosome instability with immune deficiency aggravated lung tumors; Sgo1 loss also depleted glutathione and altered Wnt signaling.
records.uncertainty: Redox and immune abnormalities identify mechanisms without showing drug rescue.

records.title: Fission Yeast Apc15 Stabilizes MCC-Cdc20-APC/C Complexes, Ensuring Efficient Cdc20 Ubiquitination and Checkpoint Arrest.
records.model: Fission-yeast Apc14/Apc15 mutants and tagged Cdc20 complexes
records.note: Apc14 and Apc15 oppositely regulated checkpoint-complex association, separating delayed silencing from defective arrest.
records.uncertainty: Protein-complex genetics supplies no administered rescue.

records.title: Mps1 Regulates Kinetochore-Microtubule Attachment Stability via the Ska Complex to Ensure Error-Free Chromosome Segregation.
records.model: PP2A-B56-depleted cells and Ska phosphomutants
records.note: Mps1 inhibition restored unstable K-fibers after PP2A-B56 depletion, linking kinase balance to Ska-mediated attachments.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor identity and completed faithful division are absent; extends the existing kinase/phosphatase compensation route.

records.title: Mad2 Overexpression Uncovers a Critical Role for TRIP13 in Mitotic Exit.
records.model: Mad2-overexpressing cells and tumor xenografts with TRIP13 manipulation
records.note: TRIP13 excess shortened Mad2-associated delay, while TRIP13 loss amplified arrest and suppressed tumor growth.
records.uncertainty: Mitotic timing and cancer proliferation effects are not nonmalignant tissue rescue.

records.title: The Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Is Required for Hematopoietic Progenitor Cell Engraftment.
records.model: Murine hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells with checkpoint abrogation
records.note: Checkpoint loss caused premature mitotic exit, chromosome damage and poor differentiation and engraftment.
records.uncertainty: Antimitotic and checkpoint-abrogating chemicals are unnamed; this directly cautions against bypass in renewing tissues.

records.title: A mitosis-specific and R loop-driven ATR pathway promotes faithful chromosome segregation.
records.model: Mitotic cells with acute ATR inhibition or degradation
records.note: Removing mitotic ATR increased whole-chromosome errors through loss of a centromeric Aurora-B/Chk1 pathway.
records.uncertainty: Chemical identity is unspecified; acute mitotic function differs from replication-stress targeting.

records.title: Mechanistic insight into TRIP13-catalyzed Mad2 structural transition and spindle checkpoint silencing.
records.model: Human TRIP13/Mad2 structural and biochemical assays
records.note: TRIP13 and p31-comet remodeled free Mad2 checkpoint complexes but could not reactivate APC/C already bound to MCC.
records.uncertainty: No administered compound or cellular restoration endpoint.

records.title: PTEN regulates spindle assembly checkpoint timing through MAD1 in interphase.
records.model: PTEN/MAD1 interphase checkpoint-complex studies
records.note: PTEN promoted MAD1 dimerization and nuclear-pore localization, supporting checkpoint timing before mitosis.
records.uncertainty: Spindle poisons are unnamed challenges; no therapeutic PTEN intervention is established.

records.title: The cohesion establishment factor Esco1 acetylates α-tubulin to ensure proper spindle assembly in oocyte meiosis.

agent_roles.role: challenge: tests microtubule stability

records.model: Mouse oocytes with Esco1 depletion, excess or catalytic mutants
records.note: Both Esco1 depletion and excess disrupted spindles; wild-type but not catalytically dead addback restored tubulin acetylation.
records.uncertainty: Genetic acetylation correction is not a drug result; increased acetylation is not uniformly beneficial.

records.title: The nonmotor adaptor HMMR dampens Eg5-mediated forces to preserve the kinetics and integrity of chromosome segregation.
records.model: HMMR-deleted or silenced cells with motor-force perturbations
records.note: Chemical Eg5 inhibition alleviated attachment instability and the segregation delay caused by HMMR loss, unlike Kif15 silencing.
records.uncertainty: The Eg5 inhibitor, dose and final aneuploidy rescue are unspecified; a defined force-balancing compensation opportunity needs primary checking.

records.title: Evidence that PP2A activity is dispensable for spindle assembly checkpoint-dependent control of Cdk1.

agent_roles.role: challenge: inhibits PP2A catalytic activity
challenge: inhibits PP2A catalytic activity

records.model: Human-cell checkpoint control of Cdk1
records.note: Two phosphatase inhibitors indicated that PP2A catalytic activity was dispensable for checkpoint-dependent Cdk1 control.
records.uncertainty: A preserved checkpoint readout does not show complete mitotic fidelity or therapeutic phosphatase inhibition.

records.title: Molecular basis of functional myogenic specification of Bona Fide multipotent adult cardiac stem cells.
records.model: Review of adult cardiac-stem-cell identity and myogenic specification
records.note: The article argues for cardiac progenitor myogenesis while acknowledging disputed cell identity and regenerative capacity.
records.uncertainty: Review advocacy is not an administered skeletal-muscle rescue experiment.

records.title: Shugoshin 1 is dislocated by KSHV-encoded LANA inducing aneuploidy.
records.model: KSHV LANA/Bub1 signaling and domain perturbations
records.note: LANA blocked Bub1-dependent phosphorylation and displaced cohesion machinery; domain-level interference attenuated aneuploidy and proliferation.
records.uncertainty: No administered antiviral or BUB1B-restorative agent is identified.

records.title: Aneuploidy in intestinal stem cells promotes gut dysplasia in Drosophila.
records.model: Drosophila intestinal stem cells with induced aneuploidy
records.note: Aneuploid stem cells accumulated without detected apoptosis; suppressing JNK signaling in these cells prevented dysplasia.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not identify a pharmacological JNK intervention or demonstrate restored chromosome number.

records.title: TRIP13 and APC15 drive mitotic exit by turnover of interphase- and unattached kinetochore-produced MCC.
records.model: TRIP13 degron and APC15/Cdc20-turnover perturbations
records.note: Combined loss of TRIP13 and APC15-dependent turnover blocked mitotic exit even without kinetochore production of new checkpoint complexes.
records.uncertainty: Dual disassembly mechanisms support timing; no therapeutic rescue drug is identified.

records.title: Mitotic regulators and the SHP2-MAPK pathway promote IR endocytosis and feedback regulation of insulin signaling.
records.model: Insulin-receptor trafficking studies and insulin sensitivity in mice
records.note: SHP2 inhibition prolonged metabolic insulin action while limiting growth signaling, improving mouse insulin sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: The abstract does not identify the inhibitory intervention; glucose sensitivity is not muscle force or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Kinetochores attached to microtubule-ends are stabilised by Astrin bound PP1 to ensure proper chromosome segregation.
records.model: Astrin-PP1 attachment-delivery perturbations and artificial tethering
records.note: Aurora-B inhibition failed to repair loss of Astrin-PP1 delivery, whereas targeted PP1 tethering restored attachment stability.
records.uncertainty: Aurora inhibitor is unnamed; constitutive PP1 delivery itself harmed congression and segregation.

records.title: CaMad2 Promotes Multiple Aspects of Genome Stability Beyond Its Direct Function in Chromosome Segregation.

agent_roles.role: challenge: antifungal pressure associated with chromosome loss

records.model: Candida albicans mad2 deletion and drug-stress assays
records.note: Mad2-deficient fungi grew better on fluconazole despite increased chromosome loss and broader genome instability.
records.uncertainty: Antifungal resistance is not improved host-cell fidelity; other challenge drugs are unnamed.

records.title: The RepID-CRL4 ubiquitin ligase complex regulates metaphase to anaphase transition via BUB3 degradation.

agent_roles.role: challenge: antitumor sensitivity after checkpoint-regulator loss

records.model: RepID/CRL4/RBBP7-deficient cells
records.note: Deficiency of the BUB3-degradation machinery delayed exit, increased instability and heightened paclitaxel sensitivity.
records.uncertainty: Target depletion supports a cancer-sensitization mechanism rather than restorative protein stabilization.

records.title: Mps1-mediated release of Mad1 from nuclear pores ensures the fidelity of chromosome segregation.
records.model: Drosophila cells and mps1-null larval neuroblasts
records.note: Preventing Mad1 binding to nuclear-pore Megator restored kinetochore recruitment and chromosome fidelity in mps1-null neuroblasts.
records.uncertainty: No administered agent implements this localization bypass; compensation is genetic.

records.title: Co-regulation of the antagonistic RepoMan:Aurora-B pair in proliferating cells.
records.model: RepoMan/Aurora-B co-regulation in cancer cells and patient associations
records.note: Balanced RepoMan/Aurora-B elevation limited segregation errors but promoted proliferation; high RepoMan sensitized cancers to Aurora inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitors are unnamed and cancer sensitivity is not nonmalignant rescue.

records.title: Mitotic slippage is determined by p31<sup>comet</sup> and the weakening of the spindle-assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Prolonged mitotic-arrest checkpoint dynamics
records.note: Progressive loss of kinetochore MAD2 and p31-comet suppression weakened arrest, allowing APC/C-driven cyclin loss and slippage.
records.uncertainty: No restorative compound is identified; mitotic escape lacks proper segregation.

records.title: Low-level X Chromosome Mosaicism: A Common Finding in Women Undergoing IVF.
records.model: Women undergoing IVF with X-mosaicism and selected blastocysts
records.note: Blood karyotyping found frequent X mosaicism; embryo testing identified euploid blastocysts for transfer and observed implantation.
records.uncertainty: Embryo selection is not chromosome repair; some reported numerator/percentage pairs are inconsistent.

records.title: Topoisomerase IIα is essential for maintenance of mitotic chromosome structure.

agent_roles.role: challenge: inducible TOP2A degradation
challenge: TOP2A poison comparator
challenge: TOP2A inhibitor comparator

records.model: Human cells with timed TOP2A degron removal
records.note: Rapid TOP2A removal collapsed chromosome compaction and prevented segregation, unlike the tested poisoning/inhibition comparators.
records.uncertainty: Protein depletion cannot be equated with every TOP2A drug effect.

records.title: A somatic evolutionary model of the dynamics of aneuploid cells during hematopoietic reconstitution.
records.model: Monte Carlo model of marrow reconstitution and aneuploid-cell selection
records.note: Modeling linked transient post-transplant aneuploidy enrichment to rapid expansion and radiation-associated niche degradation.
records.uncertainty: Computational explanations do not demonstrate an administered treatment or measured repair.

records.title: The Error-Prone Kinetochore-Microtubule Attachments During Meiosis I in Vitrified Oocytes.
records.model: Vitrified oocytes during meiosis I
records.note: Vitrification combined elevated Aurora-B/C activity with reduced Mad2 and more incorrect kinetochore attachments.
records.uncertainty: This mechanism-only injury study does not test an Aurora inhibitor or other rescue.

records.title: Ordered dephosphorylation initiated by the selective proteolysis of cyclin B drives mitotic exit.
records.model: Time-resolved mitotic-exit proteomics
records.note: Rapid degradation of a few regulators initiated much broader ordered phosphatase-driven changes during mitotic exit.
records.uncertainty: Temporal proteomics is not evidence for an administered restoration agent.

records.title: Senolytic Drugs: Reducing Senescent Cell Viability to Extend Health Span.
records.model: Review of senotherapeutic discovery and preclinical/clinical testing
records.note: The review separates selective senescent-cell killing from secretory-phenotype suppression and surveys organ/function outcomes.
records.uncertainty: No compound-specific new experiment is described in the abstract; existing senolytic route context only.

records.title: Chronic Exposure to Particulate Hexavalent Chromium Alters Cdc20 Protein Localization, Interactions and Expression.

agent_roles.role: challenge: particulate hexavalent chromium carcinogen

records.model: Human lung fibroblasts under chronic chromate exposure
records.note: Chronic zinc chromate altered kinetochore Cdc20 and weakened its interaction with Mad2, supporting checkpoint bypass.
records.uncertainty: Carcinogen-induced signaling disruption supplies no restorative intervention.

records.title: TRF1 Depletion Reveals Mutual Regulation Between Telomeres, Kinetochores, and Inner Centromeres in Mouse Oocytes.
records.model: TRF1-depleted mouse oocytes and centromere/kinetochore perturbations
records.note: TRF1 loss impaired checkpoint and attachment architecture, increasing aneuploidy; reciprocal centromere disruption shortened telomeres.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitory interventions are not chemically identified and no rescue is reported.

records.title: EML4-ALK Variant 3 Promotes Mitotic Errors and Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Deficiency Leading to Increased Microtubule Poison Sensitivity.

agent_roles.role: challenge: antimitotic cancer treatment combined with ALK inhibitors

records.model: EML4-ALK variant epithelial models and H2228/H3122 cancer cells
records.note: Variant-3 cells had hyperstable attachments and weak checkpoints; paclitaxel plus ALK inhibition synergistically reduced their survival.
records.uncertainty: ALK inhibitors are unnamed in the abstract; selective tumor killing is not restored chromosome fidelity.

records.title: Recovery from spindle checkpoint-mediated arrest requires a novel Dnt1-dependent APC/C activation mechanism.

agent_roles.role: challenge: spindle stress revealing mutant sensitivity

records.model: Fission-yeast dnt1 deletion and checkpoint recovery
records.note: Dnt1 loss prolonged inhibitory APC/C binding, lowered Cdc20 stability and delayed recovery from checkpoint arrest.
records.uncertainty: Thiabendazole is a challenge; no pharmacological restoration is shown.

records.title: Meiotic cells escape prolonged spindle checkpoint activity through kinetochore silencing and slippage.
records.model: Budding-yeast mitotic versus meiotic checkpoint assays
records.note: Meiotic cells escaped arrest roughly 150 minutes earlier than mitotic cells through kinetochore silencing and slippage.
records.uncertainty: Developmental escape mechanisms do not establish improved gamete chromosome fidelity.

records.title: UBAP2L-dependent coupling of PLK1 localization and stability during mitosis.
records.model: UBAP2L-depleted mitotic cells with excess mislocalized PLK1
records.note: Chemical PLK1 inhibition largely reversed mitotic defects after UBAP2L loss, which otherwise left excessive PLK1 activity into interphase.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitor, dose and final chromosome/function outcomes require primary checking; extends existing PLK1-normalization route.

records.title: CENP-E activation by Aurora A and B controls kinetochore fibrous corona disassembly.
records.model: CENP-E phosphorylation and kinetochore-corona dynamics
records.note: Spatial Aurora-A/B phosphorylation regulated CENP-E activation, corona retention and redistribution during congression.
records.uncertainty: The abstract proposes a regulatory axis without a named administered rescue.

records.title: MAPK-dependent control of mitotic progression in S. pombe.
records.model: Fission-yeast Pmk1 deletion under environmental stress
records.note: Pmk1 loss raised Cdc20 and weakened metaphase arrest; stress normally promoted MAPK-dependent Cdc20 degradation.
records.uncertainty: No identified drug restores this stress-dependent timing mechanism.

records.title: Phosphorylation of Mad1 at serine 18 by Mps1 is required for the full virulence of rice blast fungus, Magnaporthe oryzae.

agent_roles.role: challenge: inhibits fungal Mps1/Mad1 signaling

records.model: Magnaporthe oryzae infection-related development
records.note: Mps1-IN-1 reduced appressorium formation and virulence through lower Mad1 phosphorylation, resembling Mad1 deletion.
records.uncertainty: Crop-pathogen suppression is not mammalian checkpoint or muscle rescue.

records.title: Chromosomal aberrations and early mortality in a non-mammalian vertebrate: example from pressure-induced triploid Atlantic salmon.
records.model: Pressure-triploidized Atlantic salmon eggs and surviving parr
records.note: Suboptimal pressure increased chromosomal abnormalities and early deaths; abnormalities were rare in later survivors.
records.uncertainty: Reduced abnormality among survivors suggests selection, not correction of chromosomes; no drug intervention.

records.title: Distinct checkpoint and homolog biorientation pathways regulate meiosis I in Drosophila oocytes.

agent_roles.role: challenge: depolymerizes oocyte microtubules

records.model: Drosophila oocytes with checkpoint/kinetochore perturbations
records.note: Meiosis-I arrest persisted without SAC genes, while ROD and MPS1 separately supported homolog biorientation.
records.uncertainty: Fly meiotic checkpoint localization differs from arrest function; colchicine is not a rescue.

records.title: ARHGEF17/TEM4 regulates the cell cycle through control of G1 progression.
records.model: TEM4-depleted cells with cyclin-B addback
records.note: Cyclin-B overexpression largely corrected mitotic progression and segregation after TEM4 depletion and reduced YAP/CCNB1 expression.
records.uncertainty: This is genetic compensation, not a administered cyclin or Rho-targeted medicine.

records.title: Single-cell analysis comparing early-stage oocytes from fresh and slow-frozen/thawed human ovarian cortex reveals minimal impact of cryopreservation on the oocyte transcriptome.
records.model: 144 early-stage human oocytes from three fresh/cryopreserved ovarian donors
records.note: Immediate post-thaw transcriptomes overlapped strongly with fresh oocytes despite small coordinated pathway shifts and donor-specific histological differences.
records.uncertainty: No drug is tested; immediate RNA similarity does not establish later chromosome or live-birth equivalence.

records.title: Loss of the <i>Aspergillus fumigatus</i> spindle assembly checkpoint components, SldA or SldB, generates triazole heteroresistant conidial populations.
records.model: Aspergillus fumigatus SldA/SldB deletion and antifungal susceptibility
records.note: Checkpoint-component loss increased genome size and heteroresistance specifically to ergosterol-pathway inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Triazoles are unnamed and larger genomes only suggest aneuploidy; fungal resistance is not host restoration.

records.title: HDAC6-dependent deacetylation of SAE2 enhances SUMO1 conjugation for mitotic integrity.
records.model: Human SAE2 acetylation mutants and HDAC6 inhibition
records.note: HDAC6 inhibition or acetyl-mimetic SAE2 caused mitotic defects rescued by SUMO1 overexpression or a SUMO1-NuMA fusion.
records.uncertainty: HDAC6 inhibitor identity is absent; opposing substrate-specific evidence needs reconciliation with the existing tubulin-rescue route.

records.title: PKMYT1 has an important role in the timing and fidelity of chromosome segregation.
records.model: Mitotic cells with PKMYT1 inhibition and spindle-drug challenge
records.note: PKMYT1 inhibition accelerated anaphase, caused bridges/micronuclei and promoted checkpoint escape, activating cGAS-STING.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitors and spindle drugs are unnamed; WEE-family targets cannot be treated as interchangeable rescue mechanisms.

records.title: Network architecture determines delay robustness in the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Distributed-delay mathematical models of spindle-checkpoint networks
records.note: Model architectures differed in tolerance to molecular delays; an engineered feedback design maintained robust inhibition.
records.uncertainty: Simulated robustness is not a tested cellular or pharmacological restoration.

records.title: Chronic deregulation of the spindle assembly checkpoint triggers myelosuppression and gastrointestinal atrophy
records.model: Preprint: conditional MAD2-overexpressing mice with apoptosis-gene changes
records.note: Bim deletion protected gut tissue during chronic checkpoint activation, whereas only BCL2 excess mitigated marrow suppression.
records.uncertainty: Genetic anti-apoptotic rescue is tissue-specific; fidelity, long-term cancer outcomes and a drug implementation need follow-up.

records.title: An unconventional regulatory circuitry involving Aurora B controls anaphase onset and error-free chromosome segregation in trypanosomes
records.model: Preprint: analogue-sensitive Aurora-B and KKT14 perturbations in Trypanosoma
records.note: Aurora-B inhibition arrested parasites; KKT14 depletion bypassed arrest, while forced CPC retargeting permitted exit with massive missegregation.
records.uncertainty: Analogue identity is unnamed and bypass in noncanonical parasite kinetochores is not normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Rothmund-Thomson syndrome.
records.model: Clinical review of Rothmund-Thomson syndrome
records.note: The review distinguishes RECQL4-associated cancer risk and phenotype management from generalized premature-aging assumptions.
records.uncertainty: Laser, surgery and unspecified cancer treatment are not BUB1B muscle pharmacology; historical clinical claims are not newly verified.

records.title: Structural and functional analysis of the interaction between the nucleoporin Nup98 and the mRNA export factor Rae1.
records.model: Human Rae1/Nup98 crystal structure and RNA-binding assays
records.note: A conserved Nup98 hairpin bound Rae1 and enabled an RNA-binding complex relevant to nuclear export.
records.uncertainty: Structural characterization contains no administered therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Epigenetic repression of p16(INK4A) by latent Epstein-Barr virus requires the interaction of EBNA3A and EBNA3C with CtBP.
records.model: Recombinant EBV lymphoblastoid lines with EBNA3/CtBP changes
records.note: Viral EBNA3-CtBP interactions repressed p16 through chromatin remodeling and allowed B-cell proliferation.
records.uncertainty: Overcoming senescence here is an oncogenic mechanism, not healthy-tissue rejuvenation.

records.title: Clinical strategies and animal models for developing senolytic agents.
records.model: Senolytic animal-model and trial-design review
records.note: The review argues that clearance-mediated benefit must be distinguished from off-target effects and tested with appropriate disease models.
records.uncertainty: It outlines development requirements rather than reporting a new agent-specific rescue.

records.title: Hallmarks of progeroid syndromes: lessons from mice and reprogrammed cells.
records.model: Progeroid mouse and patient-derived reprogrammed-cell models
records.note: The review compares aging hallmarks and therapeutic limitations across progeroid models.
records.uncertainty: No particular administered intervention or efficacy result is supplied in the abstract.

records.title: Mitotic progression, arrest, exit or death relies on centromere structural integrity, rather than de novo transcription.

agent_roles.role: challenge: DNA intercalation/transcription inhibition

records.model: Human-cell live imaging, RNA-seq and mitotic-arrest assays
records.note: DNA intercalation displaced centromeric Aurora B and weakened the checkpoint, unlike transcription inhibition without intercalation.
records.uncertainty: Drug mechanism cannot be reduced to loss of new transcription; no restoration outcome.

records.title: Suppression of autophagy during mitosis via CUL4-RING ubiquitin ligases-mediated WIPI2 polyubiquitination and proteasomal degradation.

agent_roles.role: challenge: NEDD8-pathway inhibition restores mitotic autophagy

records.model: Mitotic WIPI2/CRL4 autophagy regulation
records.note: Pevonedistat preserved WIPI2 and autophagy, but restored mitotic autophagy was linked to slippage and senescence.
records.uncertainty: Restoration of a pathway is not healthy division; other chemicals appear only in the abbreviation list.

records.title: Kv10.1 Regulates Microtubule Dynamics during Mitosis.
records.model: Kv10.1/ORAI1 regulation in cancer and healthy mitotic cells
records.note: Channel inhibition stabilized microtubules, whereas Kv10.1 knockdown increased dynamics and reduced lagging chromosomes with stronger checkpoint signaling.
records.uncertainty: Inhibitory agent identities are absent; the genetic fidelity benefit must not be assigned to pharmacological channel blockade.

records.title: Prolonged oxidative stress and delayed tissue repair exacerbate acetaminophen-induced liver injury in aged mice.

agent_roles.role: challenge: acute liver injury

records.model: Young versus over-80-week-old mice
records.note: Aged livers retained depleted glutathione, damaged hepatocytes and delayed regenerative signaling after acetaminophen, with higher mortality.
records.uncertainty: No glutathione-restoring or regenerative treatment is tested.

records.title: Replication stress promotes cell elimination by extrusion.

agent_roles.role: challenge: induces replication stress and epithelial extrusion

records.model: C. elegans RNAi screen and mammalian epithelial monolayers
records.note: Hydroxyurea drove ATR/CHK1/p53-dependent cell extrusion; blocking stress responses or allowing cycle completion prevented extrusion.
records.uncertainty: Removing stressed cells is not repair of their genomes, and retention may remove tumor-suppressive protection.

records.title: Resolving Geroplasticity to the Balance of Rejuvenins and Geriatrins.
records.model: Conceptual model of environmental aging/rejuvenation factors
records.note: The authors propose balancing endogenous rejuvenating and aging-promoting factors to regulate cellular homeostasis.
records.uncertainty: The abstract provides a conceptual assertion of reversal, not an identified administered experiment.

records.title: p21 facilitates chronic lung inflammation via epithelial and endothelial cells.

agent_roles.role: challenge: repetitive inhalation causing chronic bronchitis

records.model: p21-knockout mice and lung-cell expression profiling
records.note: p21 deletion reduced senescent-cell burden and chronic lung pathology, with epithelial/endothelial contributions and improved fitness.
records.uncertainty: Lifelong deletion is not a senolytic or p21-inhibitor treatment; tissue benefit does not prove chromosome repair.

records.title: Comparison of therapeutic effects of mesenchymal stem cells derived from superficial and deep subcutaneous adipose tissues.

agent_roles.role: benefit: administered cell product
benefit: administered cell product
challenge: fibrotic signaling in HK-2 cells

records.model: Human adipose cells, conditioned-media assays and rat renal ischemia
records.note: Both adipose-cell sources similarly reduced renal fibrosis despite different proliferation, with comparable anti-inflammatory conditioned-media effects.
records.uncertainty: Cell therapy and secretome effects do not identify a single drug or establish broad intravascular safety.

records.title: Progerin, an Aberrant Spliced Form of Lamin A, Is a Potential Therapeutic Target for HGPS.
records.model: HGPS progerin mechanism and therapy review
records.note: The review links aberrant LMNA splicing to progerin toxicity and discusses inhibition and clinical development.
records.uncertainty: Progerin-targeted benefit does not transfer automatically to BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: Genetic Features of Young and Aged Animals After Peripheral Nerve Injury: Implications for Diminished Regeneration Capacity.
records.model: Injured sciatic nerves of young and aged rats
records.note: Age altered immune-cell and cell-cycle transcription after injury, with weaker early proliferative responses in older nerves.
records.uncertainty: Transcriptomic differences suggest mechanisms but no rescue intervention was administered.

records.title: NMN reverses D-galactose-induced neurodegeneration and enhances the intestinal barrier of mice by activating the Sirt1 pathway.

agent_roles.role: benefit: oral treatment after induced aging
challenge: aging induction
challenge: Sirt1 inhibition to test mechanism

records.model: D-galactose-treated mice
records.note: NMN improved behavior and intestinal integrity while suppressing inflammatory and oxidative injury; Ex527 blocked the benefit.
records.uncertainty: This extends the existing NAD precursor route through Sirt1, not Sirt2; dose and relevance to muscle or BubR1 deficiency need primary evidence.

records.title: Compartmentalization of DHCR7 links 7-DHC metabolism to B-ring unsaturated steroid synthesis in the equine fetal gonad.
records.model: Equine fetal gonads across gestation
records.note: Declining DHCR7 expression accompanies a shift toward B-ring unsaturated steroid synthesis in specific fetal gonad compartments.
records.uncertainty: Endogenous metabolites and expression patterns do not establish an administered intervention or rescue.

records.title: Senotherapeutics and Their Molecular Mechanism for Improving Aging.
records.model: Review of cellular senescence and aging
